what: Hovering a product or post photo link lays the stage color (ink black) down as background, fades the photo to .7 and scales it to 1.05 (.5s quick-attack curve), a ”VIEW DETAILS” label in the center opens from the left and slides in 1em, and an underline below is drawn from the left (.2s). On release the photo slowly returns over 1s. Pressed: 1.03 scale

options.look: read: Article list type — label ”READ MORE” · underline 4.5em
options.--fx-line: Underline length, default 5.5em (4.5em for READ MORE)

use: · Post list: data-fx-view-label-hover="look: read"

from.where: shared.css .c-hover-zoom — photo links in product lists·journal lists·article detail (original .c-hover-image--zoom :hover)
